items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: that was a lyric that I put to a Stan Getz solo off the Stan Getz, Kenny Barron “People Time.”

ctx.x: Do you have a certain style of jazz that is your favorite?

Yeah. I try to take in, there’s different parts of me that, there’s a side of me that’s a real bebopper. Vocally I love the lyrics of Eddie Jefferson, Jon Hendricks doing — I love writing lyrics to solos. Well last night, the “East of the Sun,” that was a lyric that I put to a Stan Getz solo off the Stan Getz, Kenny Barron “People Time.” I love that. But at the same time there’s nothing as fun as just a nice medium blues groove, and just to play and just to feel the groove and to be able to support others.…
So you live in Los Angeles now?
